subject: Pricing ladder request — hosted API pricing for high-throughput retail use
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Kevin Wu <kevin.wu@fastretail.com>; procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing inquiry: Hosted API for retail recommender (est. 20B tokens/mo)

Hi Olga,

We evaluated Redwood's hosted API in our PoC and are looking to build a production recommender that will generate ~20B tokens/month by Q4. Procurement asked me to get a clear baseline rate card and to understand how you structure tiered discounts / slabs for sustained throughput. Specifically: 

- What is the baseline per-token hosted rate for inference today (no commitment)?
- Do you have published tier breaks and discount percentages for 1B, 5B, 20B+ volumes?
- How do committed vs flexible billing compare (term, overage handling, credits)?
- Any promo or ramp credits for a new enterprise customer?

Can you send the current rate card and any sample pricing addendum? Procurement (procurement@fastretail.com) is looped.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Head of ML Platforms
FastRetail Inc.
Mobile: +1-415-555-0123

Attachments: none
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
Cc: Kevin Wu <kevin.wu@fastretail.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry: Hosted API for retail recommender (est. 20B tokens/mo)

Hi Lisa — great to hear the PoC went well. Below is a concise summary of hosted pricing and typical options; attaching our Q2 rate card for reference. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through scenarios.

Quick baseline (hosted API, pay-as-you-go / no commitment):
- 0 — 1B tokens/mo: $0.00060 per token
- 1B — 5B tokens/mo: $0.00050 per token
- 5B — 20B tokens/mo: $0.00035 per token
- 20B+ : enterprise tier — contact for customized slab

Committed terms (12 months) typically get an additional ~10% off listed rates; 24-months can be discussed for steeper discounts. We also offer ramp credits for new customers (one-time) and a technical onboarding credit applied to first invoice for volume ramp.

Notes on mechanics:
- Overage: if you commit to a slab we bill committed amount monthly; overages are billed at the committed slab rate unless you enable auto-burst into a higher-capacity tier.
- Discounts: apply to token usage only; platform fees (monitoring/retention) remain separate.
- SLA: hosted API SLAs available on enterprise plans (99.9% for production endpoints); dedicated pools for tighter latency SLAs.

I've attached: redwood_hosted_ratecard_q2_2026.pdf (summary) and a short link to the pricing addendum template. If you'd like a bespoke slab for 20B we typically propose a blended/custom slab + commit.

Available for a call tomorrow afternoon PT. What time works best?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1-650-555-0199

Attachments: redwood_hosted_ratecard_q2_2026.pdf
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com; Kevin Wu <kevin.wu@fastretail.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry: Hosted API for retail recommender (est. 20B tokens/mo)

Thanks, Olga — that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement and our finance team: 

1) Competitors have given us indicative pricing closer to $0.00025 — $0.00030 per token at sustained 20B volumes (with a 12-mo commit). To be competitive we need a more aggressive discount band.
2) Is there a meaningful difference in unit economics if we take Redwood Dedicated versus Hosted API for this workload? We care about predictable latency and cost.
3) For committed slabs: are there mid-term true-ups / quarterly recons? How do you handle caching benefits (we expect high prefix reuse)?

Kevin (procurement manager) — can you work with Olga on standard MSA timelines? If you can prepare a pricing addendum and indicate what level of discount engineering can approve, that will speed things up.

Cheers,
Lisa

Attachments: internal procurement notes (not attached)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai; aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing inquiry: Hosted API for retail recommender (est. 20B tokens/mo) — need pricing guidance

Team — looping you in on FastRetail (deal FR-2026-026). They pushed back on our public slab; they need a competitive offer near $0.00025–0.00030/token at sustained 20B.

Context:
- PoC success, will commit if economics line up.
- They care about predictable spend and latency; may consider Dedicated if unit cost improves.
- Procurement wants a pricing addendum and MSA timeline.

Request:
- Ben: can you confirm operational improvements (caching, batching) we can count on and what effective per-token discount that yields? Any throughput constraints for single-tenant pools at 20B/mo?
- Aditya: pricing approval bands — how far can we go on a 12-mo commit vs. 24-mo? Is there standard promotional credit we can offer for first 3 months?

Would like a proposed counteroffer I can share with procurement by EOD.

Thanks,
Olga

(Internal)
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai; aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing inquiry: Hosted API for retail recommender (est. 20B tokens/mo) — need pricing guidance

Olga / Aditya — quick technical + pricing suggestion:

- From throughput perspective, a single dedicated pool (A100-class or comparable) can support the sustained concurrent throughput for FastRetail with autoscaling; no technical blocker for 20B/mo. We should size to expected RPS distribution and KV cache hit rates.
- Operational discounts from caching/batching: with expected prefix reuse we typically see 8–12% effective token reduction; conservative estimate 8%. We can factor that into the commercial model as a technical credit (line-item) rather than reduce listed per-token price.

Proposed commercial slab (12-month commit, payable monthly):
- 0 — 5B: $0.00048 per token
- 5B — 20B: $0.00030 per token
- 20B+: $0.00026 per token (negotiable with 24-mo/50% prepay)

Additional levers:
- 6% one-time onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice to offset ramp costs.
- If they prepay 30% of the annual committed spend upfront we can provide additional 4% off the blended price.

Attachments: throughput_profile_fastretail.csv (sample cost model + hit-rate assumptions)

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry: Hosted API for retail recommender (est. 20B tokens/mo)

Lisa — thanks for the candid note and for sharing procurement. Based on Ben's sizing and conservative cache assumptions, here's a practical counteroffer we can present quickly: 

Counteroffer (12-month committed slab):
- 0 — 5B: $0.00048 / token
- 5B — 20B: $0.00030 / token
- 20B+: $0.00026 / token (requires 24-month term or 50% prepay)
- One-time onboarding credit: 6% of first-month invoice
- Prepay option: 4% additional blended discount for 30% annual prepayment

We can also provide a 2-month free technical onboarding window (trial credits applied) and an SLA addendum for production endpoints on the enterprise addendum. I've attached the pricing addendum template and a DocuSign link to accelerate the MSA + pricing addendum if you want to proceed.

Please confirm the procurement contact (is procurement@fastretail.com the correct mailbox) and whether you prefer a Hosted vs Dedicated proposal — if Dedicated, we'll include an expected latency SLAs and an alternate cost schedule. If this looks reasonable I can route the addendum for signature and lock the pricing for 10 business days.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
